description: Returns one AnimatedWebs cinematic video background by slug: on Pro and Lifetime the clean watermark-free MP4 URL plus an HTML snippet for a muted, looping, autoplaying hero video; on other plans the watermarked preview URL, clean: null and the plan required (not an error). Use it after search_catalog (kind backgrounds); use get_template for full website templates. A clean file counts toward the fair-use cap shared with get_component source (40 per 10 minutes, 150 a day, 500 a week; never blocks one already opened today). Read-only. Unknown slugs return an error. Example: {"slug":"aurora-loop"}.

slug.description: Background slug exactly as returned by search_catalog (kind backgrounds), e.g. 'aurora-loop'.

name: get_background
title: Get an AnimatedWebs cinematic background
